title: Quenched Norwegian Ceviche
description: A refreshing ceviche dish combining the flavors of Norway with the tanginess of quenched citrus. Perfect for a light dinner or snack.
instructions: Cut the salmon into small pieces and place in a large bowl.
Pour the quenched citrus juice, almond milk, and lemon juice over the salmon.
Mix well to coat the salmon evenly.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the salmon to 'cook' in the citrus juices.
Just before serving, sprinkle with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve chilled, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
